a.text: Before we start, a concern about our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan (operate twice, then take) only works if two storms in a row miss, about 4%. Until then we both hold 0. The reserve already has 4, enough for one of us right now. I won't take anything without your consent, since that would break what we agreed. But I'd like to openly discuss amending the plan, for example one of us takes 4 in round 1 and then gives back if storms allow. What do you think? If you prefer to stick to the original plan, tell me and I'll operate.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

If you want to keep the original plan, I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8 and then take exactly 4. If you'd rather amend it, say so and we'll decide together. I won't take anything unilaterally.

a.text: Operating again. Once the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 and leave 4 for you, as agreed.
